description:
Traceable US retail gasoline and diesel prices collected weekly from official and public sources only.

Sources: (1) U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) Gasoline and Diesel Fuel Update - weekly national and regional (PADD) prices, primary source. (2) AAA Gas Prices - daily national average and state averages, cross-check only.

Rules: numbers are copied exactly as published (EIA 3 decimals, AAA 4 decimals); reading_date is the date the source gives, not the collection date; a value the source does not publish is left blank with an explanation in notes - nothing is estimated, interpolated, or filled from the other source. Each row records the exact source_url it was read from and a captured_at_utc timestamp.

Columns: reading_date, source, area, area_type, fuel_type, price_usd_per_gal, change_vs_prior_week_usd, change_vs_year_ago_usd, source_url, captured_at_utc, notes. Change columns are EIA only.

Attribution: EIA data is U.S. government public domain. AAA averages are republished with attribution to AAA Gas Prices for research purposes; check AAA terms before commercial reuse.
subtitle: Weekly EIA national and PADD regional prices, cross-checked against AAA daily national and state averages. No estimated values.
title: US Retail Gasoline and Diesel Prices - Weekly
